events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album' upon the world. A double album that broke all the rules and still sounds incredible. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched, and he would have been 80 today. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: A true game-changer! 61 years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and shaped the sound of a generation.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the passing of John Lennon, the iconic co-founder of The Beatles, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, whose powerful music and message of peace continue to resonate. He would have been 86 today.

events.title: Remembering David Bowie, who would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary 'Starman' David Bowie was born on this day in 1947 and would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Chameleon of Rock
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and legacy of the ever-evolving David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. His artistry continues to inspire.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley, who would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935 and would have been 92 years old.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. Long live the King!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page was born on this day in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll forever. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, celebrating his 82nd birthday today! An absolute icon with a career spanning decades.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice behind so many classic Madness hits. What's your favourite?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his blue-eyed soul hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', was born on this day in 1956.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still loving those smooth blue-eyed soul classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary American singer-songwriter Dolly Parton, known for her prolific career and iconic style, was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon of music, business, and pure joy. What's your favourite Dolly song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The lead singer of Take That, Gary Barlow, an acclaimed English singer-songwriter and producer, was born on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his incredible solo work, a true songwriting talent.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, famous for his string of international hits in the 70s and 80s, was born on this day in 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legend that is Billy Ocean! Still 'Suddenly' feeling good when his hits come on.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring rock's founding legends.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who was in that legendary inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That heartthrob to successful solo artist, he's still got it.
